channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: Sixty years turn a spaceflight into two surnames and a date
item.description: Space.com's November anniversary note keeps the launch date and the crew names. The problem the flight was sent to solve has no field in that format.

item.title: Alien invasions promise a fight, and the warning has none
item.description: A Guardian interview lends an alarming sentence to an alien-invasion frame. The frame is what breaks, and the ending is where to look.

item.title: Second pass through Webb data finds a planet that was never hidden
item.description: The reduction moved a detection limit rather than the object, and that is exactly what the next paper has to confirm.

item.title: A deadline alone cannot carry astronauts back to the Moon
item.description: The target year for a crewed return arrives with no dependency list, and the missing engineering answers are the story

item.title: A Gravitational Lens Schedules Two More Arrivals of One Supernova
item.description: Seventy years between images is a hard test of a fitted mass model, and a stranger will run it.

item.title: A Candidate Neutron Star Crowds the Mass Gap
item.description: One heavy object would test the equation of state that every neutron star obeys, if the mass can be measured properly.

item.title: NASA Stakes Ten Billion Dollars on Lunar Infrastructure Contracts
item.description: New procurement documents outline multibillion-dollar investments for a permanent moon base and experimental nuclear propulsion systems.

item.title: Little Red Dots challenge early universe models
item.description: James Webb Space Telescope observations suggest compact, high-redshift objects that may be primordial black holes.

item.title: M John Harrison Breaks the Booker Prize Boundary for Science Fiction
item.description: The selection of The End of Everything forces literary institutions to recognize speculative mechanics.

item.title: NASA Loses Swift After Rescue Attempt Fails in Upper Atmosphere
item.description: A failed docking effort seals the fate of an aging gamma-ray sentinel in low Earth orbit.
